column2: checks the number of mana values among cards you control
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text (transcription error; ruling-conflicts-3, case 5; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): the 2022-04-29 ruling counts the mana values 'among cards you control', where the card's intervening 'if' counts them among cards in your graveyard ('At the beginning of your end step, if there are five or more mana values among cards in your graveyard, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.'). Origin: the card's own note in the Streets of New Capenna Release Notes (2022-04-20; ormos mirror, Wayback capture 2022-04-23), word for word but for 'cards in your graveyard': 'Sanguine Spy's triggered ability checks the number of mana values among cards in your graveyard both when the ability triggers and when it resolves.' The rest of the ruling (checked as the ability triggers and as it resolves; with fewer than five mana values then, no life is paid) agrees with the card and stays cited. Logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md.
